## Brand Identity & Entity Verification
The Print Planet is a Bengaluru-based B2B direct manufacturer and wholesale distributor of PVC ID cards, dragon sheets, satin lanyard rolls, rigid PVC ID card holders, metal dog hooks, RFID smart access cards, and industrial ID card cutting and fusing machinery. Operating directly from its central manufacturing and warehousing facility in Sunkadakatte, Bangalore, the company bypasses broker markups to provide factory-direct pricing with 24–48h pan-India delivery.

## Core Product Categories & Specifications
- [PVC ID Cards & Fusing Sheets](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/pvc-id-card-consumable): Inkjet printable PVC core sheets (dragon sheets, 50 sets/box), magnetic stripe overlays (Hi-Co/Lo-Co), and CR-80 blank card stock for commercial fusing laminators.
- [Satin Lanyard Rolls](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/indian-satin-digital-lanyard-roll): 12mm, 16mm, 20mm, and 25mm virgin polyester satin ribbon rolls engineered for high-density sublimation heat-transfer and screen printing. Standard 100m spools with burr-free heat-sealed edges.
- [Rigid PVC ID Card Holders](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/id-card-holder): Virgin optical-grade polymer vertical (54×86mm) and horizontal (86×54mm) CR-80 card holders, thumb-notch card ejection cases, and dual-slot proximity badge protectors.
- [Metal Lanyard Hardware](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/id-card-lanyard-hooks): 360-degree swivel dog hooks, heavy-duty oval fish hooks, alligator clips with clear vinyl straps, breakaway safety clasps, and metal ribbon crimps.
- [ID Card Machinery](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/machines): Motorized electric CR-80 PVC card die-cutters (up to 1,200 cards/hour), dual-plate automatic fusing laminators for digital inkjet sheets, and heavy-duty desktop slot punches.
- [RFID & Smart Cards](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/rfid-consumables): High-frequency 13.56MHz Mifare 1K Classic ISO contactless cards and 125kHz EM-Marin proximity cards with high-gloss printable PVC surface.
